title: Nuclei Isolation from Snap Frozen Human Pancreatic Tissue
author: Luca Tosti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tpxempn

steps.title: Initial Tissue Processing
steps.instruction: Transfer the tissue into the douncer, crush it with one stroke of the loose pestle, and dislodge the tissue from the bottom using a P200 tip if necessary.

steps.title: Buffer Addition and Initial Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of cold S25 buffer to the douncer placed on ice and incubate for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue using a combination of pestle strokes and incubation periods.

substeps.instruction: Crush the tissue with 5 strokes of the loose pestle.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 4 °C on ice.
Homogenize with 3 more strokes of the loose pestle and 5 more strokes with the tight pestle.

steps.title: Filtration and Washing
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through a FACS-tube with a cell strainer cap (35 μm) and wash the filter with 250 μL of S25 buffer.

steps.title: First Nuclei Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the nuclei suspension to a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 4 °C, 500g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Nuclei Recovery and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant, leaving a few μL of liquid at the bottom, and resuspend in 300 μL S25 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Load 10 μL of nuclei suspension into a Countess™ Cell Counting Chamber Slide.
Use brightfield to evaluate debris amount and overall nuclei integrity.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Purification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei in an appropriate volume of Resuspension Buffer based on the desired final concentration (accounting for a potential 20% loss during previous centrifugation).

steps.title: Secondary Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 4 °C, 500g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final Wash and Recovery
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei in 1 mL of S25 buffer and repeat the centrifugation step (4 °C, 500g for 5 minutes).

steps.title: Final Counting and Downstream Processing
steps.instruction: Count the nuclei and proceed with FACS sorting or direct encapsulation in oil droplets.
